alloy: all a: Axiom | (some v: Unit | cites[a, v] and v not in Axiom) implies a in Misnesting
doubt: Type mismatch: Axiom extends Unit, but Misnesting extends Finding. Interpreting as: an axiom with citation error should be marked as having a misnesting finding.

alloy: all f: Fact | (some u: Unit | cites[f, u]) implies f in Misnesting
doubt: Type mismatch: Fact extends Unit, but Misnesting extends Finding. Interpreting as: any fact that cites should be marked as misnesting.

alloy: all s: Spec | (some u: Unit | cites[s, u] and u not in Axiom and u not in Spec and u not in Fact) implies s in Misnesting
doubt: Type constraint interpretation: spec citing a unit that is neither axiom, spec, nor fact results in misnesting.

alloy: all e: Exception | (some u: Unit | cites[e, u] and u not in Spec and u not in Fact) implies e in Misnesting
doubt: Interpreting as: exception citing non-spec/fact results in misnesting.

alloy: all b: Bug | (some Runner and not tested[b]) implies b in Untesting
doubt: Interpreting: if project has runner and bug is not tested, report untesting.

alloy: all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding
doubt: Interpreting hidden conflicts as generating findings.

alloy: all c: Conflict | ((some Tracker and (no i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue)) or (some i: Issue | c->i in Name.issue and i not in Known)) implies c in Untracking
doubt: Conflict names no issue or unknown issue with tracker present yields untracking.

alloy: all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding
doubt: Adrift tests generate findings.

alloy: all t: Test | t in Declared and (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel) implies t in Uncitation
doubt: Declared test without tag generates uncitation.

alloy: all t: Test | (t in Declared and (some u: Unit | checks[t, u] and u not in Claim)) implies t in Misaiming
doubt: Test checking non-claim unit generates misaiming.

alloy: all d1: Document | (some d2: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel) implies d2->d1 in Context.rel and all d3: Document | (d2->d3 in Context.rel and d3->d1 in Extend.rel) implies d2->d1 in Context.rel
doubt: Context is transitive through extension.

alloy: all f: Fence | (f in Languaged and (some u: Unit | f->u in Within.rel)) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
doubt: Languaged fence in unit's text is read as block of that unit.

alloy: all f: Fence | f not in Languaged implies f not in Blocks.rel
doubt: Fence with no language is block of no unit.

alloy: all f: Fence | f in VocabularyWord implies f in VocabularyBlock
doubt: Second word is vocabulary means fence has vocabulary role.

alloy: no Tracker implies no Untracking
doubt: No tracker means no untracking findings reported.

alloy: (some f: Listing | some e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel and e->Unfound in Spell.rel) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | not c in Core and not (some p: Installed | c in p->Add.rel)) or (some r: Run, p: Plugin | r->Return.code2[p]) implies (some r: Run | r in Exits2)
doubt: Run exits with code 2 for multiple conditions.

alloy: all p: Plugin, d: Document | (applies[p, d] iff ((some c: Command | (some r: Run | r->c in Ask.rel) and c not in Given) and applies[p, d]))
doubt: Complex bidirectional rule about plugin application.

alloy: all f: Frontmatter | f in Unclosed implies f in Refused
doubt: Unclosed frontmatter cannot be read.

alloy: all f: Frontmatter | f in Unterminated implies f in Refused
doubt: Unterminated frontmatter cannot be read.

alloy: all f: Frontmatter | f in Doubled implies f in Refused
doubt: Doubled frontmatter cannot be read.

alloy: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not c in Core and not (some p: Installed | c in p->Add.rel)) implies (r in Unknown and r in Exits2)
doubt: Unknown unavailable command causes exit code 2.

alloy: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies r in Unknown
doubt: Unavailable command is reported as unknown.

alloy: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies r in Exits2
doubt: Asking for unavailable command causes exit code 2.

alloy: all d1: Document | (all d2: Document | (d1->Head.rel = d2->Head.rel) implies ((some Finding | true) iff (some f: Finding | true)))
doubt: Docs differing only in frontmatter have same finding presence.

alloy: some a: Axiom, s: Spec, t: Test, d: Document, i: Index | (s->a in Sit.rel and t->s in Carry.rel and a in d->Hold.units and s in d->Hold.units and i in d->Hold.indexes and i->d in Match.rel and no Finding)
doubt: Possibility witness: valid axiom/spec/test/doc with no findings.

alloy: some b: Bug, e: Test, i: Issue | (b->i in Name.issue and i in Known and i not in Closed and e in ExpectedFailure and checks[e, b] and no Finding)
doubt: Possibility witness: tracked bug with expected failure and no findings.

alloy: some unit_1, unit_2: Unit, conflict_1: Conflict, issue_1: Issue | (unit_1 != unit_2 and conflict_1->issue_1 in Name.issue and issue_1 in Known and issue_1 not in Closed and conflict_1->unit_1 in Name.between and conflict_1->unit_2 in Name.between and no Finding)
doubt: Possibility witness: tracked conflict with two units and no findings.

alloy: all u: Unit | ((u in Unsayable) or (u in Twofold)) implies u in Unsayable
doubt: Unit with no reading for formula word or multiple formulas cannot be said in words.

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Wordless and u in Stated) implies u in Unsayable
doubt: Formula with unreadable word cannot be said in words.

alloy: all u: Unit | u in Twofold implies u in Unsayable
doubt: Multiple formulas in unit make formula unsayable.

alloy: all r: Run | (r in CheckCommand and some Unit | Unit in Reported) implies r not in Exits0
doubt: Check command with reported statement yields non-zero exit.

alloy: all r: Run | (r in GenerateCommand and some u: Unit | u in Handwritten and u in Reported) implies r not in Exits0
doubt: Generate command with reported handwritten statement yields non-zero exit.

alloy: all r: Run, g: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->g in Ask.rel and u in Unsayable and u in Explained) implies r not in Exits0
doubt: Generate with unsayable formula yields non-zero exit.

alloy: all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
doubt: Undeclared/misplaced/apart/unused words are flagged.

alloy: all d1, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d1 in Checked and d2 not in Checked and d2->d1 in Context.rel and u in d2->Hold.units) implies u not in Rewritten
doubt: Unit in context not checked is not rewritten when generating.

alloy: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u->w in Voice.rel and (some u2: Unit | u2->d in Introduce.rel and (some d: Document | d->u2 in Context.rel and d->u in Context.rel))) implies w not in Undeclared
doubt: Word declared in context is not undeclared.

alloy: all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u in Named and all s: Scenario | s in Impossible implies s in Raised
doubt: Units held with contradictions are named; impossible scenarios are reported.

alloy: all s: Scenario | s in Impossible implies (all u: Unit | u->s in Frees.rel implies u in Blame.rel)
doubt: Each unit freeing impossible scenario is named in report.

alloy: all s: Scenario, u: Unit | u->s in Blame.rel implies u->s in Frees.rel
doubt: Unit named in scenario report lets scenario happen when removed.

alloy: all u: Unit | u in Contradicting implies u->Scenario in Blame.rel
doubt: All contradicting units are named in contradiction report.

alloy: all u1, u2: Unit, s: Scenario | (u1 in Contradicting and u1->u2 in Together.rel) implies u2->s in Blame.rel
doubt: Analyzer finding contradicting units together names both in report.

alloy: all u: Unit, w: Word | (u in Stated and u not in Term and w in Signature and w in loneOn[u,w]) implies u in Expose.rel
doubt: Formula lone on word is reported when conditions hold.

alloy: all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (u2->w in Utter.rel) implies u1 not in Expose.rel
doubt: Word named outside declaration prevents lone-on report.

alloy: all u1, u2: Unit, w: Word | (u2->w in Picture.rel) implies u1 not in Expose.rel
doubt: Word in scenario prevents lone-on report.

alloy: all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst) implies l in OneLine
doubt: Rule with single clauses each, no time first, said on one line.

alloy: all d: Definition | (d in GuardedByKind and byKind[d]) implies d in PhrasePerKind
doubt: Definition with alternatives per kind, each beginning with kind, can be said per kind.

alloy: all d: Definition | (d in SameKindTwice and byKind[d]) implies d in JoinedWithOr
doubt: Two alternatives for one kind, said kind by kind, joined by or.

alloy: all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach implies q in InFull
doubt: Quantifier with no fact for variable beside another is said in full.

alloy: all q: Quantifier | q in NoWithAnother implies q in InFull
doubt: Quantifier saying no variable differs from another and holds condition is said in full.

alloy: all q: Quantifier | q in TimedCondition implies q in InFull
doubt: Quantifier with time-phrase condition is said in full.

alloy: all l: Series | l in NotClause implies l in AsBullets
doubt: List with multi-clause item is said as bullets.

alloy: all l: Series | (l in AndInOr) implies l in KeepsAndApart
doubt: List with and in alternative is said as bullets kept apart.

alloy: all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l in TimeSecond) implies l in KeepsThen
doubt: Rule with time only in second side has then before time.

alloy: all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l not in TimeSecond) implies l in DropsThen
doubt: Rule without time phrases is said without then.

alloy: some l: Series | (l in Few and l in MoreThanTwo and l in CommaItem)
doubt: Possibility: list with three or fewer clauses, more than two, with comma.

alloy: some l: Series | (l in Few and l in TooLong)
doubt: Possibility: list short but long in sentence context.

alloy: some l: Series | (l in Items and l in SharedSubject and l in Many)
doubt: Possibility: list with same-subject clauses, more than three.

alloy: some owner_1, owner_2: Owner, failing_cleanup_1: Failing | (owner_2->owner_1 in handler and eventually (owner_1 in Disposed and failing_cleanup_1->owner_1 in on) and eventually (failing_cleanup_1 in Ran) and eventually (failing_cleanup_1.reached = owner_2))
doubt: Fixture: error from cleanup eventually reaches boundary handler.
